# Country scope. Clear all three active Oprichnina throttle tier modifiers before switching tiers.
oe_ru2_clear_oprich_tiers = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ru2_oprich_harsh } remove_country_modifier = oe_ru2_oprich_harsh }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ru2_oprich_balanced } remove_country_modifier = oe_ru2_oprich_balanced }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ru2_oprich_release } remove_country_modifier = oe_ru2_oprich_release }
}

# Country scope. Inject Pomor Arctic fur & shipbuilding demand into Novgorod's market (strictly guarded).
oe_ru2_push_pomor_demand = {
    location:novgorod = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = market }
            market = {
                add_temporary_demand = {
                    type = demand:oe_ru2_pomor_arctic_demand
                    years = 5
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Safely adjust Lubeck owner's opinion (has_owner = yes guarded).
oe_ru2_lubeck_opinion = {
    location:lubeck = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = {
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { this = root } }
                    add_opinion = { target = root modifier = $bias$ }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
